entries.message: This update includes only update unwatched episodes when marking a season watched and reset develop identity after main releases.
entries.author: Lasikiewicz
details: Partially watched seasons update only the episodes that are still unwatched
Existing watched episodes remain unchanged when completing a season
Fully watched seasons retain the explicit Resync season action
Develop builds display the released version alongside their cycle build number
Main promotions restart local develop metadata at the released version and build 1
Version-aware update checks ignore higher build counters from older release cycles
messageFragments: Fix - Only update unwatched episodes when marking a season watched
Fix - Reset develop identity after main releases
